# plan-24 device specs

One section per device. The device itself — pins, bus, registers, protocol, conversion, ready pins, DAC registers, clock — is `specs/<ID>.json` in the form `schema.md` defines (plan-24-D §3, plan-24-F §2); this file indexes them. Generated by `census/specs_md.py`; do not edit by hand.

## ADC (516 devices)

### ADC0802

8-bit 100 us microprocessor-compatible SAR ADC with differential input, on-chip clock and 3-state data bus. `specs/ADC0802.json`; datasheet `adc0804-n.pdf` (p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC: VCC 4.5-5.5 V), p.5 (TC 103-114 us at fCLK 640 kHz, 66-73 clocks), p.6 (tACC 135/200 ns, t1H/t0H 125/200 ns, tWI/tRI 300/450 ns, VIN(1) up to 15 V), p.7 (Figures 1-2), p.11 (start F/F, INTR), p.14 (CS/RD/WR active low), p.28 (restart, free-running)).

- Bus: parallel 8-bit
- 8 bits, 1 channel(s), code straight; vcc [4.5, 5.5]
- 0 registers, 1 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 114000 ns; start command
- Ready: INTR
- Packages: DW (SOIC-20W)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input, VREF/2 span adjustment and the differential VIN(-) offset (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)
  - the conversion is clocked by CLK IN / the CLK R RC oscillator (64 clocks + up to 8 clocks of start latency); the model uses the fixed 114 us maximum at fCLK = 640 kHz
  - CLK IN Schmitt trigger and CLK R RC oscillator output (CLK R is never driven)
  - a new start (CS and WR low) also resets INTR; ready clears only on a read of the result
  - the converter is held in reset while CS and WR stay low (the model starts at WR/CS release, which matches)
  - restart during a conversion leaves the previous result in the output latch
  - free-running mode with INTR tied to WR and the power-up initialising WR pulse
  - INTR delay from WR/RD falling (tWI/tRI 450 ns max), and the 8-clock INTR SET pulse when CS and RD are held low
  - pin names: DB0 (LSB) is named DB0, VCC (or VREF) is named VCC (its use as the upper ladder reference is analog), VIN(–) is written VIN(-)

- Bus: clocked 8-bit
- 8 bits, 1 channel(s), code straight; vcc [2.4, 3.6]
- 0 registers, 0 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 0 ns; start power-on
- Packages: PW (TSSOP-24)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input and reference ladder (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)
  - pipeline latency of 2.5 clock cycles (the code is constant); sampling on CLK falling, output valid tOD after CLK rising
  - clock frequency limits (20-70 MHz) and the ~1 us recovery after the clock restarts or PD goes low

### ADC081C021

8-bit 189 kSPS I2C SAR ADC with out-of-range alert. `specs/ADC081C021.json`; datasheet `adc081c021.pdf` (p.3 connection diagrams (Figures 1 and 3), p.4 pin descriptions and package pinouts table, p.5 (operating ratings: VA 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs 0-5.5 V regardless of VA), p.8 (conversion time 1 us), p.15 (conversion at each result read / automatic mode), p.16 (straight binary), p.17-22 (registers), p.22-23 (read/write sequences), p.24 (Table 2 slave addresses)).

- Bus: I2C 0x54
- 8 bits, 1 channel(s), code straight; vcc [2.7, 5.5]
- 8 registers, 1 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 1000 ns; start read
- Packages: DDC (SOT23-THIN-6), DGK (VSSOP-8-DGK)
- Not modeled:
  - VSSOP-8 address straps ADDR0/ADDR1 (tri-level: GND, floating, VA; 9 addresses 0x50-0x5A, Table 2): the pins exist only in the DGK pinout, so the bus uses the SOT-6 fixed address 0x54 (1010100) for both packages (= DGK with ADDR1 = GND, ADDR0 floating)
  - ALERT output (open drain, polarity CONFIG.POLARITY, enable CONFIG.ALERT_PIN_EN): never asserted
  - analog input (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)
  - the CONVERSION register holds the 8-bit code in bits 11:4 (left-justified in a 12-bit field); the schema does not say where a result register's code goes (identical here: the code is 0)
  - automatic conversion mode (CONFIG.CYCLE_TIME != 0: conversions every Tconvert x 32..2048) - the schema's mode field takes one continuous value; CYCLE_TIME is stored only
  - alert function: VHIGH/VLOW/VHYST comparison, ALERT_STATUS flags (write-1-to-clear), the CONVERSION.ALERT_FLAG bit, VMIN/VMAX tracking in automatic mode
  - conversion starts at the ACK of the address byte of a read (about 400 ns acquisition + conversion, 1 us typ); the model starts the next conversion after each read of the result
  - reserved bits of the 16-bit limit registers read 0 but VHIGH/VMIN reset to 0FFFh per the datasheet (bits 3:0 set); they are marked read-only
  - I2C Hs-mode master code entry, quiet interface mode, automatic power-down between conversions
  - power-on reset brown-out behaviour (registers lost below 2.4 V)

### ADC081S021

8-bit 50-200 kSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial output. `specs/ADC081S021.json`; datasheet `adc081s021.pdf` (p.3 (pins, DBV and NGF same numbering), p.4 (ROC: VA 2.7-5.25 V, digital inputs -0.3 to 5.25 V regardless of VA, SCLK 25 kHz-20 MHz), p.7 (tEN 20 ns, tACC 40 ns at 2.7-3.6 V, tDIS 25 ns; Figure 2: SCLK idles high, data out on falling edges, 3 leading zeros, 8 data bits, 4 trailing zeros, TRI-STATE after the 16th falling edge), p.12 (conversion at CS fall, frame), p.13 (straight binary), p.14 (normal / shutdown mode)).

- Bus: SPI mode 3, read-only
- 8 bits, 1 channel(s), code straight; vcc [2.7, 5.25]
- 0 registers, 0 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 0 ns; start cs-fall
- Packages: DBV (SOT23-6), NGF (WSON-6-NGF)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input; the conversion is clocked by SCLK (the result is the 0 V code 0x00 at once)
  - SPI mode 3 (SCLK idles high, data out on falling edges, read on rising edges); with SCLK low at CS fall the receiver captures an extra leading zero (datasheet), which mode 3 does not show
  - SDATA goes TRI-STATE after the 16th falling SCLK edge (idle "z" after the 15 pattern bits) or at CS rise
  - shutdown mode: CS high between the 2nd and 10th SCLK falling edges powers down until the next CS fall (no visible digital effect: the next CS fall wakes it; the 1 us power-up time is not modeled)
  - CS high between the 10th and 16th falling edges aborts the conversion (SDATA to TRI-STATE)
  - tQUIET / tACQ and SCLK frequency limits; tACC is 20 ns at VA 4.75-5.25 V (the model uses 40 ns)

### ADC0820

8-bit 1.5 us half-flash microprocessor-compatible ADC with track/hold and 3-state data bus. `specs/ADC0820.json`; datasheet `adc0820-n.pdf` (p.2 (operating ratings: VCC 4.5-8 V), p.4 (VIN(1) 2.0 V CS/WR/RD, 3.5 V Mode), p.5 (tCRD 2.5 us, tI 800/1300 ns, tACC2 120/150 ns, t1H/t0H 200 ns, tINTH 225 ns, tRDY 100 ns), p.6-7 (Figures 4-7), p.10 (pin descriptions)).

- Bus: parallel 8-bit
- 8 bits, 1 channel(s), code straight; vcc [4.5, 8]
- 0 registers, 1 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 1300 ns; start command
- Ready: INT
- Packages: DW (SOIC-20W)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input, VREF(+)/VREF(-) span (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)
  - only WR-RD mode (MODE pin high) is modeled: WR/RDY is the WR input, the conversion is started by CS+WR and INT goes low tI (1300 ns max) after WR rises. The MODE pin is not read
  - RD mode (MODE low, the power-on default: MODE has an internal 50 uA pull-down): RD low starts the conversion and the data appear on DB0-DB7 at its end (tCRD 2.5 us max) in the same read; pin 6 is then RDY, an open-drain output low from CS fall until the result is latched
  - WR-RD mode reading before tI (RD low earlier latches the result at RD fall, INT low tRD+290 ns)
  - INT is also reset by the rising edge of CS; INT state at power-up is undefined
  - OFL overflow output (always driven, low when VIN > VREF(+); high for the 0 V code) is not driven
  - conversion starts at the WR falling edge in the datasheet; the model starts it at WR/CS release and times tI from there (which is how the datasheet times INT)
  - tWR / tRD minimum (600 ns) and maximum (50 us) widths, tP 500 ns between conversions
  - pin names: VREF(−) is written VREF(-); Mode is written MODE

### ADC082S021

8-bit 2-channel 50-200 kSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface. `specs/ADC082S021.json`; datasheet `adc082s021.pdf` (p.1 connection diagram, p.2 pin descriptions; p.3 operating ratings (VA 2.7-5.25 V, digital inputs -0.3 V to VA); p.5 output coding and AC characteristics (straight binary, tCONV 13 SCLK, throughput 16 SCLK); p.6 timing specifications (tEN 30, tACC 30, tDIS 20 ns max); p.7 Figures 2 and 4 (frame: Z3-Z0 zeros, DB7-DB0, 4 zeros; DIN DONTC DONTC ADD2 ADD1 ADD0 DONTC DONTC DONTC); p.17-18 using the ADC082S021, Tables 2-4 (control register, channel selection, multiple conversions per frame)).

- Bus: SPI mode 3
- 8 bits, 2 channel(s), code straight; vcc [2.7, 5.25]
- 1 registers, 1 commands; frame stream
- Conversion: 0 ns; start cs-fall
- Packages: DGK (VSSOP-8-DGK)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs and multiplexer (every conversion returns the 0 V code 0x00); the channel field is stored only
  - ADD1 = 1 is not allowed (DOUT indeterminate); the model outputs the 0 V code anyway
  - the conversion is clocked by SCLK (3 track + 13 conversion clocks); not timed, the result is the 0 V code at once
  - the control word selects the channel of the NEXT conversion (pipelined); with a constant 0 V code this has no visible effect
  - SPI mode 3 chosen: Figure 4 shows SCLK idling high, DOUT changing on falling edges, DIN sampled on rising edges; the datasheet allows SCLK high or low at CS fall (tCSU/tCLH), and with SCLK low at CS fall the internal SCLK sees CS fall as the first falling edge
  - several conversions per frame (each frame an integer multiple of 16 SCLKs): modeled by the 16-bit stream command and idle "repeat"; the track/hold re-entry timing is not modeled
  - power-down while CS is high and between continuous conversions (no digital effect)
  - SCLK frequency limits (0.8-3.2 MHz specified; 50 kHz-16 MHz functional), tCSU/tCLH, tACQ and throughput
  - tEN/tACC 30 ns are the maxima; typical values are lower at 5 V

### ADC0831

8-bit serial-output SAR ADC with one differential input (32 us conversion). `specs/ADC0831.json`; datasheet `adc0832-n.pdf` (p.2 (Figure 6 NPA pinout), p.3 (operating ratings: VCC 4.5-6.3 V), p.5 (TTL input levels, TRI-STATE output), p.6 (AC: fCLK 10-400 kHz, tC 8 clocks, tpd 1500 ns, t1H/t0H 250 ns), p.9 (Figures 15-18), p.13 (Table 1: one differential input, no addressing), p.15-16 (digital interface)).

- Bus: SPI mode 0, read-only
- 8 bits, 1 channel(s), code straight; vcc [4.5, 6.3]
- 0 registers, 0 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 0 ns; start cs-fall
- Packages: NPA (SOIC-14-NPA)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input, VREF span (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)
  - the conversion starts on the first CLK rising edge after CS falls (Figure 17); DO leaves TRI-STATE with a leading zero at the first falling edge, then D7..D0 on the following falling edges; the model shifts z, 0, D7..D0 (the first bit z is the TRI-STATE before the first falling edge)
  - after the LSB the datasheet does not show the DO level for the ADC0831 (LSB-first output is not available on it); the model drives 0 until CS rises
  - the conversion is clocked by CLK (8 clock periods after the MUX settling clock); not timed, the result is the 0 V code at once
  - fCLK 10-400 kHz, 40-60 % duty cycle, tSET-UP 250 ns / tHOLD 90 ns; tpd is 1500 ns max MSB-first and 600 ns LSB-first (the model uses 1500 ns for every bit)
  - all internal registers are cleared while CS is high; a new conversion needs a CS high-to-low transition
  - V+ shunt regulator (zener) input and the V+ / VCC diode
  - codeFormat: straight binary for a single-ended or positive differential input; a negative differential input reads 0x00

### ADC0834

8-bit serial I/O SAR ADC with 4-channel multiplexer (single-ended or differential). `specs/ADC0834.json`; datasheet `adc0832-n.pdf` (p.2 (Figure 3 NPA pinout), p.3 (operating ratings: VCC 4.5-6.3 V), p.5 (TTL input levels, TRI-STATE output), p.6 (AC: fCLK 10-400 kHz, tC 8 clocks, tSET-UP 250 ns, tHOLD 90 ns, tpd 1500/600 ns, t1H/t0H 250 ns), p.9 (Figures 15-16), p.10 (Figure 20), p.14 (Tables 4-5), p.15-16 (digital interface steps 1-9)).

- Bus: SPI mode 0
- 8 bits, 4 channel(s), code straight; vcc [4.5, 6.3]
- 1 registers, 2 commands; frame stream
- Conversion: 0 ns; start command
- Ready: SARS
- Packages: NPA (SOIC-14-NPA)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs, multiplexer, single-ended / differential selection and VREF span (stored only; the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)
  - DI is ignored after the MUX address until CS rises (p.15-16); the model's stream frame keeps matching DI, so a 1 on DI during the output restarts the reply. Hold DI low after the address; the one-wire DI/DO tie (p.16) is not supported
  - DO is TRI-STATE from CS fall until the MUX-settling clock; the model shifts z for at most 32 leading clocks before a start bit
  - SARS: high from the MUX-settling half clock to the end of the 8-clock conversion and TRI-STATE while CS is high; with the clocked conversion (time 0) the model only drives it low
  - the conversion is clocked by CLK (8 clock periods after the MUX settling clock); not timed, the result is the 0 V code at once
  - fCLK 10-400 kHz, 40-60 % duty cycle, tSET-UP 250 ns / tHOLD 90 ns; tpd is 1500 ns max MSB-first and 600 ns LSB-first (the model uses 1500 ns for every bit)

  - fCLK 10-400 kHz, 40-60 % duty cycle, tSET-UP 250 ns / tHOLD 90 ns; tpd is 1500 ns max MSB-first and 600 ns LSB-first (the model uses 1500 ns for every bit)

- Not modeled:
  - ADR0 floating (or at VA/2) selects 0x50 (1010000): the tie table has no floating state; GND = 0x51 and VA = 0x52 are modeled (Table 3), SCL/SDA ties are not listed
  - CONFIG.ALERT_PIN_EN and CONFIG.POLARITY do not apply (no ALERT pin); stored only
  - analog input (the result is always the 0 V code 0x000)
  - conversion starts at the ACK of the address byte of a read (about 400 ns acquisition + 1 us typ conversion); the model starts the next conversion after each read of the result (1 us, the typical value: no maximum is given)
  - automatic conversion mode (CONFIG.CYCLE_TIME != 0) is modeled as continuous conversions, each lasting the cycle interval 1 / typical fconvert of the p.20 table (27 ... 0.4 ksps)
  - alert function: VHIGH/VLOW/VHYST comparison, setting of the ALERT_STATUS flags and of CONVERSION.ALERT_FLAG, VMIN/VMAX tracking in automatic mode (registers are stored only)
  - reserved bits of the 16-bit limit registers read 0, but VHIGH/VMIN reset to 0FFFh per the datasheet (bits 1:0 set); they are marked read-only so the reset value reads back as 0FFFh
  - I2C Hs-mode master code entry (00001xxx), quiet interface mode, automatic power-down between conversions
  - power-on reset brown-out behaviour (registers lost below 2.4 V)

Self-calibrating 12-bit plus sign 2-channel serial I/O ADC with MUX and sample/hold. `specs/ADC12130.json`; datasheet `adc12130.pdf` (p.2 (Figure 1 16-pin: CH0 1 CH1 2 COM3 DOR4 EOC5 VREF- 6 VREF+ 7 DGND8 VA+ 9 CONV10 CS11 DO12 DI13 SCLK14 CCLK15 VD+ 16), p.3-4 (pin descriptions: DI on SCLK rising, DO on SCLK falling, first bit at CS fall, CS low with SCLK low, EOC low while busy), p.5 (operating ratings V+ = VA+ = VD+ 3.0-5.5 V), p.9 (tC 44 tCK max = 8.8 us at 5 MHz), p.10 (tA 7/11/19/35 tCK max, tCAL 4944 tCK, tAZ 76 tCK), p.11 (tACC 60 ns, tDDO 90 ns, t1H/t0H 100 ns), p.28 (Table 1 data out formats), p.29 (Table 3 ADC12130 MUX addressing, Table 4 mode programming: ADC12130 DI0 DI1 DI2-DI5, power-up defaults, Table 5 CONV/PD), p.30 (Table 6 status register DB0-DB8), p.31-32 (configuration sequence, 8-bit instruction, SCLKs per format), p.39 (12-bit + sign two's complement codes)).

- Bus: SPI mode 0
- 13 bits, 2 channel(s), code twos; vcc [3.0, 5.5]
- 2 registers, 14 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 10200–15800 ns by CTRL.ACQ; start command
- Ready: EOC
- Packages: DW (SOIC-16W)
- Not modeled:
  - analog side: self-calibration (Auto Cal, tCAL 4944 tCK) and Auto Zero (76 tCK) are accepted as no-ops (EOC does not go low for them; STATUS.CAL stays 0); power-up sequence 700 us
  - output word length and order (Table 1): 12/13/16/17 bits, MSB or LSB first, with or without sign; the 0 V code is all zeros in every format, so the output is modeled as 13 zero bits then zeros; the formats are recorded in STATUS
  - the output of an I/O sequence is the result of the PREVIOUS conversion (pipelined); the constant 0 V code makes this invisible
  - Read Status: the status word is output during the next instruction (modeled with next "[STATUS]"); its bit order on DO (DB0 first assumed) and the status word length are not stated beyond Table 6; PU/PD/CAL in-progress bits stay 0
  - CONV pin: high = read data only (DI ignored, no conversion started); cannot gate commands on a pin level, so DI is always decoded
  - DOR output (low while data is shifted out, high after the last bit) is not driven
  - CS held low continuously (I/O sequences counted by SCLK, first bit on the EOC rising edge); CS falling during a conversion aborts it
  - CCLK (conversion clock) is not used: conversion time is fixed at fCK = 5 MHz (max acquisition + 44 tCK)
  - conversion starts when the instruction's 8th bit is in (the datasheet starts acquisition after the instruction / end of the I/O sequence)
  - multiplexer modes (differential CH0/CH1 vs single-ended to COM, Table 3): codes 0/2 = CH0, 1/3 = CH1 via channelMap
  - test mode (CH1-CH7 become outputs): STATUS.TEST only
  - PD pin and A/DIN, MUXOUT pins exist only on the 20/28-pin family members (ADC12132/ADC12138)

### ADC128D818

12-bit 8-channel delta-sigma ADC system monitor with temperature sensor, limit registers and I2C interface. `specs/ADC128D818.json`; datasheet `adc128d818.pdf` (p.4-5 (pins), p.6 (ROC: V+ 3.0-5.5 V; SCL, SDA, A0, A1, INT -0.05 to 5.5 V), p.9 (I2C timing), p.16 (Table 1 modes, interface), p.17 (Table 2 addresses 1Dh-37h), p.17-18 (Figures 26-31), p.19 (Table 3 register summary and defaults), p.20-27 (Tables 4-15), p.29 (straight binary DOUT = VIN/VREF x 4096), p.30 (interrupt structure, clearing), p.33-34 (quick start, POR, conversion rate, one-shot, deep shutdown, readings)).

- Bus: I2C 0x1D, 0x1F, 0x35, 0x37
- 12 bits, 8 channel(s), code straight; vcc [3.0, 5.5]
- 35 registers, 1 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 8.9e+07–7.28e+08 ns by CONV_RATE.RATE; start write:CONFIG.START=1, write:ONE_SHOT.ONE_SHOT=1, power-on
- Packages: PW (TSSOP-16)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs, internal/external reference, single-ended/pseudo-differential modes (ADV_CONFIG is stored only); the temperature sensor: the temperature reading (27h in modes 0, 2, 3) reads 0 (0 C) like every other reading
  - tri-level address pins: the MID level (A0 or A1 at mid-supply: addresses 1Eh, 2Dh, 2Eh, 2Fh, 36h) cannot be expressed; the table gives the four LOW/HIGH combinations
  - round-robin monitoring is modeled as one conversion per cycle of all channels: 89 ms in continuous mode (7 x 12.2 ms + 3.6 ms, mode 0 with every channel enabled) and ~728 ms in low power mode; CH_DISABLE and the mode do not change the time
  - INT_Clear = 1 (its power-on value) also stops the monitoring loop: the model runs continuously while START = 1 regardless of INT_Clear
  - the one-shot trigger needs bit 0 = 1 in the written value (the datasheet: any write to 09h starts a cycle)
  - Not Ready (BUSY_STATUS bit 1, set at power-on) is cleared by a conversion cycle that the model starts at power-on (one low-power cycle, ~728 ms; the datasheet: at least 33 ms)
  - limit comparison, interrupt status flags, INT pin (open-drain, active low), INT_Enable / INT_Clear / mask logic and temperature hysteresis: INT is never driven
  - Initialization bit (CONFIG bit 7, restores defaults and self-clears) and the reading/status reset on CH_DISABLE or ADV_CONFIG writes; deep shutdown
  - power-on values of the Channel Readings and Limit Registers are indeterminate (0 used); the alignment of the 12-bit reading in the 16-bit register is not given (the 0 V code is 0 either way)
  - readings not updated while a bus transaction is in progress; I2C time-out (25-35 ms), fast mode timing limits

- Bus: clocked 14-bit; config SPI mode 0
- 14 bits, 1 channel(s), code twos; vcc [1.75, 1.85]
- 88 registers, 3 commands; frame stream
- Conversion: —
- Packages: RSB (WQFN-40-RSB)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input, references, auto-zero and clock biasing (the result is always the 0 V code 0x0000, two's complement)
  - pipeline latency (1 clock cycle) is not modeled (the code is constant); data change tPD (7 ns max) after the sampling clock falling edge, DCLK follows the inverted clock

- 8 bits, 2 channel(s), code twos; vcc [1.7, 3.4]
- 0 registers, 0 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: —

- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs, internal reference and input buffers; the result is always the 0 V code 0x00 (two's complement, M2 tied to GND, the default pull-down)
  - M0/M1/M2 are multi-level strap pins (GND / 0.5 V / 1 V / AVDD, Table 7-2): M2 selects differential or single-ended input and two's complement or offset binary (offset binary would give 0x80); M1 = AVDD selects the static test pattern (D7:D4 and D3:D0 groups of all 0s / all 1s, Figures 7-7, 7-8); M0 selects DDR (GND, dual channel) or SDR (AVDD, single channel).   - RESET (active high, pin 9) has no registers to reset on this pin-controlled part; PDN power-down wake-up time (30 us) is not modeled
  - pin 5 is listed under both NC and DGND in Table 5-1 and as NC in Figure 5-1; modeled as NC (either way it connects to ground)
  - GND is the thermal pad (AGND), not a numbered pin
  - digital inputs CLK, RESET, PDN, M0, M1, M2 are referred to AVDD (1.7-1.9 V, abs max 2.1 V, Table 7-1); vcc is the union of the IOVDD ranges 1.7-1.9 V and 3.2-3.4 V (outputs D0-D7, DCLK)
  - sampling clock range (25 / 65 / 125 MSPS maximum per grade) and duty cycle
  - DDR output (Figure 6-1): channel A on one DCLK phase and channel B on the other, both on D7..D0 within one sample period; the model drives the one 8-bit code (identical 0 V code for A and B) once per sampling clock falling edge

  - M0/M1/M2 are multi-level strap pins (GND / 0.5 V / 1 V / AVDD, Table 7-2): M2 selects differential or single-ended input and two's complement or offset binary (offset binary would give 0x80); M1 = AVDD selects the static test pattern (D7:D4 and D3:D0 groups of all 0s / all 1s, Figures 7-7, 7-8); M0 selects DDR (GND, dual channel) or SDR (AVDD, single channel). None of these change the modeled output (always ADC data, two's complement)
  - DCLK# (pin 29, printed DCLK with an overline: the inverse data clock) is not driven: the clocked bus has a single clockOut pin (DCLK, pin 30)
  - pipeline latency (1 clock cycle) and aperture delay are not modeled (the code is constant); DCLK rises tPD = TS/4 + 3 ns (nominal, no max given) after the sampling clock falling edge, used as tOut (5.0 ns at 125 MSPS)
  - RESET (active high, pin 9) has no registers to reset on this pin-controlled part; PDN power-down wake-up time (30 us) is not modeled
  - pin 5 is listed under both NC and DGND in Table 5-1 and as NC in Figure 5-1; modeled as NC (either way it connects to ground)
  - GND is the thermal pad (AGND), not a numbered pin
  - digital inputs CLK, RESET, PDN, M0, M1, M2 are referred to AVDD (1.7-1.9 V, abs max 2.1 V, Table 7-1); vcc is the union of the IOVDD ranges 1.7-1.9 V and 3.2-3.4 V (outputs D0-D7, DCLK)
  - sampling clock range (25 / 65 / 125 MSPS maximum per grade) and duty cycle
  - INBP/NC and INBM/NC (pins 14, 15) are NC on the single-channel device (role nc); SDR output (Figure 6-2), data change at the DCLK rising edge

### ADC3910D025

Dual 10-bit 25 MSPS low-latency low-power ADC with parallel DDR/SDR or serial CMOS outputs and SPI configuration. `specs/ADC3910D025.json`; datasheet `adc3910d125.pdf` (p.3-4 (pins), p.5 (ROC: AVDD 1.7-1.9 V, IOVDD 1.7-1.9 or 3.2-3.4 V), p.8 (digital inputs referred to AVDD), p.12-13 (timing; SPI tOD 10.8 ns, tODZ 14 ns max; latency 1 clock), p.14-15 (Figures 5-1/5-2: DDR/SDR 10-bit on D11..D2), p.48 (two's complement default), p.49 (power down), p.50-51 (Table 6-4, 24-bit SPI words: R/W, A[14:0], D[7:0]), p.52-113 (register map; per-register page in each register note)).

- Bus: clocked 10-bit; config SPI mode 0
- 10 bits, 2 channel(s), code twos; vcc [1.7, 3.4]
- 258 registers, 3 commands; frame stream
- Conversion: —
- Packages: RSM (VQFN-32-RSM)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs (channels A and B), internal/external reference, VCM output (the result is always the 0 V code 0x000, two's complement, on both channels)
  - pipeline latency (1 clock cycle in low latency mode, 5 with the digital features) is not modeled (the code is constant); data change tPD (TS/4 + 3 ns) after the sampling clock falling edge
  - DCLK is modeled as the inverted sampling clock (it rises tPD after the CLK falling edge); DCLK/FCLK (the inverse data clock by default, or the frame clock with FCLK_EN) is not driven
  - only the default output interface is modeled: DDR, channel A on DCLK rising and channel B on DCLK falling edges of each sample; the clocked bus has one active edge, so the model drives one 10-bit word (the 0 V code) per sampling-clock falling edge on D11..D2 (Table 6-4: DDR, 10 lanes).  HDDR, SDR/DDR selection, serial CMOS (SERIALIZATION), DCLK divider, output data width (12/16-bit), output bit mapper (0xAE-0xB3), D1/D0 lanes, pin strengths and DCLK delays are stored only
  - DDC/decimation, digital comparators and hysteresis, statistics engine (0xE4-0x1A4 read 0), alerts (0x1AF-0x1ED), channel corrections (gain/offset), interleaving, test patterns (0x91-0x95, 0xA1-0xA6) and offset-binary output (FORMAT, FORMAT_DIG) do not change the output code
  - the ALERT pin (digital window comparator / over-range alert) is not driven
  - power-down: global/fast/channel power-down bits are stored only; the OEN/PD pin is modeled as the active-low output enable (its default); used as a power-down pin (OENZ_PDN, active high) it is not modeled
  - R/W = 1 disables further register writes until the next write cycle (read-back mode); words beyond a multiple of 24 bits are ignored
  - SPI is 3-wire: SDIO carries both directions (configBus mosi and miso are the same pin)
  - CFG_ALERT (0x38) reads 1 at once (the datasheet: ready 2000 clock cycles after reset release, reset value 0h)
  - the datasheet lists two registers at 0x91 (TEST_PAT_CFG, TEST_PATTERN_CFG) and at 0xD3 (COMP_HYSTERISIS_CHB_11:8, COMP_SLEW): each pair is merged into one register
  - register names containing ":" (e.g. TEST_PATTERN_CHB_7:0) are written with "_"; statistics/alert registers with hex names (0x0E4) are named R0E4; field names are the table's, wrapped lines joined
  - digital inputs RESET, OEN/PD, SCLK, SEN, SDIO are referred to AVDD (VIH 1.4 V, absolute maximum 2.1 V) and SDIO output to AVDD; vcc is the IOVDD range of the CMOS data outputs (1.7-1.9 V or 3.2-3.4 V): with IOVDD = 3.3 V the control inputs must still stay at or below 1.9 V, which the vcc range cannot say
  - the pin table lists NC as pin 17 (VREF's number); the pinout drawing shows NC on pin 5, used here
  - timing: tOut is the SPI SDIO output delay tOD 10.8 ns max and tFloat tODZ 14 ns max (the clocked data bus uses the same tOut)
  - sampling rate limits (25 MSPS max), SPI SCLK 20 MHz max, wake-up time

  - analog inputs and multiplexer; the conversion is clocked by SCLK (13 SCLK cycles), not timed: the result is the 0 V code 0x000 at once
  - the channel written in a frame applies to the next conversion (one-sample delay); with every result the 0 V code this has no visible effect (ADD is stored only)
  - ADD2-ADD0 = 111 selects GND (an eighth, internal input): stored as channel 7
  - continuous conversion frames (N x 16 SCLKs per CS low) are approximated by repeating the 16-bit output pattern and re-matching the control word every 16 bits
  - SPI mode 3 chosen (DOUT changes on SCLK falling edges, DIN and DOUT sampled on rising edges); the datasheet allows SCLK high or low at CS fall (with SCLK low, CS fall acts as the first falling edge; the first leading zero may then not be set up in time)
  - power-down while CS is high (no digital effect); t1a/t1b setup, SCLK 50 kHz-8 MHz and duty-cycle limits
  - AVDD is also the reference; DVDD 2.7 V to AVDD and digital inputs 0 V to AVDD (vcc 2.7-5.25 V)

  - RESET command recovery time (50 us + 32 tCLK)

  - analog inputs, PGA, buffer, current DACs, offset DAC, burnout sources, internal reference (stored only); offset/full-scale calibration registers are stored but not applied
  - POL pin (SCLK polarity): modeled with POL = 0 (SPI mode 1, DIN latched on the falling edge, DOUT changed on the rising edge); POL = 1 is mode 3
  - BIT_ORDER = 1 (LSB-first output) and U/B = 1 (unipolar; the 0 V code is 0 in both formats)
  - conversion time = 1 / data rate at the default decimation ratio 1920 (DEC = 780h) and fOSC = 2.4576 MHz: 10 Hz (SPEED = 0, fMOD = fOSC/128) or 5 Hz (SPEED = 1); other DEC values and clock frequencies do not change it; SMODE filter settling is not modeled
  - RDATAC replies with one result; the continuous-read mode (data output at every DRDY without a command, commands ignored until STOPC) is not modeled
  - RAM bank copies (CREG, CREGA, CRAM), checksums (CSRAMX, CSARAMX, CSREG, CSRAM, CSARAM) and calibration commands (SELFCAL, SELFOCAL, SELFGCAL, SYSOCAL, SYSGCAL) are accepted and ignored; RAM access past 7Fh does not wrap to 00h
  - digital I/O D0-D7 are not driven and DIO reads return the written value, not the pin levels
  - SCLK reset pattern, the t6 / t11 command delays, the DOR update hold-off
  - DSYNC pin and command restart the conversion; the WAKEUP needed after the DSYNC command (ADS1216) is not enforced
  - XIN / XOUT crystal oscillator: the clock pins are not used

- 24 bits, 2 channel(s), code twos; vcc [2.7, 5.5]

- Ready: DRDY/DOUT

  - commands are decoded after their first byte (the datasheet executes them at the 16th SCLK, and CS rising before byte 2 aborts them); the second byte (arbitrary, or the WREG data) follows

  - CRC mode (MODE3.CRCENB: CRC-2 input check, echo byte 2, Out CRC bytes, CRCERR) is not modeled
  - optional STATUS byte before the conversion data (MODE3.STATENB = 1) is not output
  - software power-down (MODE3.PWDN) is stored only; the PWDN pin works
  - conversion restart on a write to MODE0, MODE1, REF, PGA or INPMUX (Table 27 Restart column)
  - LOCK sets STATUS.LOCK but register writes are not blocked
  - DRDY pulses high 16 fCLK before the next completion in continuous mode when data was not read (tw(DRH)); old/new data race within 16 fCLK of completion
  - serial interface auto-reset (MODE3.SPITIM, 65536 fCLK timeout)
  - calibration commands SYOCAL, GANCAL, SFOCAL (OFCAL/FSCAL updates) do nothing
  - GPIOs on AIN0-AIN3 (MODE2/MODE3 GPIO fields stored only) and ac-bridge excitation outputs ACX1/ACX2
  - external clock on CLKIN (data rates scale with fCLK; the model uses the 7.3728 MHz nominal values)
  - RREG of an address outside 00h-11h returns 00h

### ADS1240

24-bit 4-input delta-sigma ADC with PGA (1-128), offset DAC, data I/O pins, SPI interface, 15 SPS (2.4576 MHz). `specs/ADS1240.json`; datasheet `ads1240.pdf` (p.2 (digital characteristics), p.5 (pins), p.6 (timing), p.11 (Table I data rates), p.14 (SPI, POL, DRDY, DSYNC), p.15-17 (registers), p.18-20 (commands)).

- Bus: SPI mode 1
- 24 bits, 4 channel(s), code twos; vcc [2.7, 5.25]
- 16 registers, 14 commands; frame stream
- Conversion: 6.66667e+07–5.33333e+08 ns by ACR.SPEED+ACR.DR; start power-on, command
- Ready: DRDY
- Packages: DB (SSOP-24)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs, PGA, buffer, burnout current sources, offset DAC (ODAC stored only), RANGE and U/B (unipolar format, U/B = 1, is not applied to the 0 V code: it is 000000h in both formats)
  - conversion time at the nominal fOSC = 2.4576 MHz: 1 / (fOSC / (128 * 2^SPEED * 1280 * 2^DR)); other XIN clock frequencies (1-5 MHz) scale it; DR = 11 (reserved) uses the largest value
  - DOR2..DOR0 are not loaded with the result (the 24-bit code spans three 8-bit registers); they read 0, which is the 0 V code
  - ACR.DRDY: reset X0h, the bit duplicates the DRDY pin; modeled 0 at reset, 0 at each completion, 1 after the result is read
  - DRDY also goes high t18 (4 tOSC) before each output-register update when the data was not read; modeled as cleared by a read only
  - BIT ORDER = 1 (LSB-first output bytes) is stored only; output is always MSB first
  - RDATAC continuous read mode (data on each DRDY without a command, DIN watched for STOPC/RESET) is approximated by one RDATA reply
  - self and system calibration commands (OCR/FSR update, two or four tDATA) do nothing
  - RREG/WREG address wrap-around past register 0Fh
  - SCLK reset waveform (t12/t14/t15 pattern) and serial interface reset after 3 DRDY periods with no SCLK
  - data I/O function of the AINx/Dx pins (IOCON, DIR, DIO registers stored only; DIO reads do not return the pin levels)
  - t6 delay (50 tOSC) between command and DOUT data, t11 command spacing
  - POL pin (SCLK polarity): modeled as POL = 0 (SPI mode 1, SCLK idles low); POL = 1 is mode 3
  - DSYNC pin (falling edge resets the digital filter, serial interface off while low) and BUFEN pin (buffer enable, ANDed with ACR.BUFEN)

24-bit 15 SPS delta-sigma ADC with 2-wire serial interface (DRDY/DOUT, SCLK), self-calibration, MSOP-10. `specs/ADS1244.json`; datasheet `ads1244.pdf` (p.2 (pins), p.3 (EC), p.8 (DRDY/DOUT, SCLK), p.10 (power-up, data format), p.11 (retrieval timing), p.12-13 (calibration, sleep)).

- Bus: SPI mode 1 (2-wire, no CS), read-only
- 24 bits, 1 channel(s), code twos; vcc [1.8, 3.6]
- 0 registers, 0 commands; frame fixed

- Ready: DRDY/DOUT
- Packages: DGS (VSSOP-10)

### ADS1246

24-bit 2 kSPS 1-channel delta-sigma ADC with PGA and SPI interface. `specs/ADS1246.json`; datasheet `ads1246.pdf` (p.5-6 (pins), p.8 (ROC), p.11-12 (timing), p.36-39 (conversion control, Table 13/14), p.42-44 (serial interface, data format), p.44-49 (commands), p.50-68 (registers)).

- Bus: SPI mode 1
- 24 bits, 1 channel(s), code twos; vcc [2.7, 5.25]
- 11 registers, 13 commands; frame stream
- Conversion: 575000–2.00295e+08 ns by SYS0.DR; start pin, command
- Ready: DOUT/DRDY, DRDY
- Packages: PW (TSSOP-16)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input, PGA, burn-out sources, bias voltage, system monitors (MUXCAL), offset/full-scale calibration math (registers are stored only)
  - calibration commands SYSOCAL, SYSGCAL, SELFOCAL (nop; OFC/FSC are not updated, DRDY does not pulse after tCAL)
  - FSC0-FSC2 reset to factory-trimmed values per PGA setting (xxh) and are reloaded when PGA changes: modeled reset 0
  - ID revision nibble (factory, xh) and CLKSTAT (1 with an external clock) modeled 0
  - SDATAC/RDATAC: the model always loads new results onto DOUT (read-data-continuous); in SDATAC mode the datasheet holds DOUT for RREG and needs RDATA
  - RDATAC/SDATAC take effect only at the next DRDY; commands taking effect only with START high (in power-down only RDATA, RDATAC, SDATAC, WAKEUP, NOP work)
  - writes to MUX0/BCS, VBIAS, MUX1, SYS0 reset the digital filter and restart the conversion
  - conversion times are Table 13 (START rising edge to DRDY, fCLK = 4.096 MHz); later continuous conversions are slightly shorter (Table 14); an external CLK scales them; the CLK pin is not used
  - SLEEP completes the current conversion before powering down; WAKEUP with START low does nothing
  - DRDY is forced high on the first SCLK falling edge after it falls (any SCLK, not only result reads), and pulses high for tPWH = 3 tCLK when the result is not read; DOUT/DRDY forced high by the first SCLK after the data (idle '1')
  - START pulse single-conversion mode: after one conversion the device powers down until START rises again (modeled as continuous while START is high)
  - RREG count past the last register wraps to address 0; any command sent during an RREG reply is ignored
  - power-up / RESET hold (216 tCLK, 0.6 ms) before SPI works; SPI timeout after 64 conversion cycles with CS tied low
  - restricted command F1h
  - tValid (CS fall to DOUT) not specified; tOut is tDOPD for DVDD <= 3.6 V (180 ns above 3.6 V)

  - commands blocked during an RREG/WREG/RDATA until it completes; RREG past the last register outputs zeros; WREG past it is ignored
  - DRDY returns high on the first SCLK falling edge (any command), and pulses high for tw(DRH) = 24 tCLK when the data were not read; only RREG, RDATA and WAKEUP work in power-down

- Packages: RHB (VQFN-32-5X5), RHM (VQFN-32-RHM)

  - commands are decoded after their first byte (the datasheet executes them at the 16th SCLK, and CS rising before byte 2 aborts them); the second byte (arbitrary, or the WREG data) follows
  - DOUT/DRDY outputs FFh during byte 1 and the echo of byte 1 during byte 2 (except for NOP, see its note); idle after a reply is 1
  - CRC mode (MODE3.CRCENB: CRC-2 input check, echo byte 2, Out CRC bytes, CRCERR) is not modeled
  - optional STATUS byte before the conversion data (MODE3.STATENB = 1) is not output

  - conversion restart on a write to MODE0, MODE1, REF, PGA, INPMUX or INPBIAS (Table 29 Restart column)
  - LOCK sets STATUS.LOCK but register writes are not blocked
  - DRDY pulses high 16 fCLK before the next completion in continuous mode when data was not read (tw(DRH)); old/new data race within 16 fCLK of completion
  - serial interface auto-reset (MODE3.SPITIM, 65536 fCLK timeout)
  - calibration commands SYOCAL, GANCAL, SFOCAL (OFCAL/FSCAL updates) do nothing
  - GPIOs on AIN2-AIN5 and ac-excitation (CHOP = 10/11) on the ADS1261 (MODE2/MODE3 GPIO fields stored only)
  - external clock on CLKIN (data rates scale with fCLK; the model uses the 7.3728 MHz values, and the 40 kSPS setting DR >= 10000b assumes fCLK = 10.24 MHz)
  - RREG of an address outside 00h-12h returns 00h
  - FIR filter is only defined for 2.5, 5, 10 and 20 SPS; sinc5 is used for 14.4 kSPS and above whatever FILTER says (Table 8); undefined combinations use the largest time

16-bit 2-channel simultaneous-sampling delta-sigma ADC with PGA, automotive, SPI. `specs/ADS130B02.json`; datasheet `ads130b02-q1.pdf` (p.3 pin functions (Table 5-1), p.5 recommended operating conditions, p.8 timing and switching characteristics, p.16-19 clocking and OSR, p.22-25 reset, conversion modes, standby, sync, p.26-29 serial interface, frames and words, p.30 data format (Table 8-8), p.31-34 commands (Table 8-9), p.36-44 registers (Table 8-10)).

- Bus: SPI mode 1
- 16 bits, 2 channel(s), code twos; vcc [2.7, 3.6]
- 11 registers, 10 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 31250–1.6e+07 ns by CLOCK.PWR+CLOCK.OSR; start power-on
- Ready: DRDY
- Packages: PW (TSSOP-20)
- Not modeled:
  - analog: PGA gains, input mux and dc test signals, internal reference (stored only); the result is the 0 V code
  - word length: modeled at the power-on 24-bit word size (MODE.WLENGTH = 01b); 16-bit and 32-bit words (and the 32-bit sign-extended format) change every frame and are not modeled
  - output CRC word (CCITT/ANSI, seed FFFFh) is output as zeros; input CRC checking (RX_CRC_EN), CRC_ERR and the register-map CRC (REG_CRC_EN, REGMAP_CRC, STATUS.REG_MAP) are not modeled
  - multi-register RREG (only the first register follows the 111a... acknowledgment) and multi-register WREG (only the first register is written): the registers are 16 bits each, zero-padded to 24-bit words on the bus, which a wreg/rreg count cannot express
  - STATUS mirrors MODE.RESET / WLENGTH / CRC_TYPE and LOCK, F_RESYNC: only LOCK (set by LOCK/UNLOCK) and DRDYx are modeled
  - LOCK: commands other than NULL, RREG and UNLOCK are still executed while locked
  - channel enable bits (CHx_EN): disabled channels still output the 0 V code
  - global-chop mode (GLOBAL_CHOP_CFG.GC_EN, GC_DLY) and its longer conversion period; fast-settling filter at start-up and filter settling after changes
  - conversion time = OSR / fMOD at the nominal clocks (fMOD 4.096 MHz high-resolution, 2.048 MHz low-power, 1.024 MHz very-low-power, Table 8-3); external CLKIN frequency vs internal oscillator (CLK_SEL) not modeled
  - DRDY: goes high when all channels' data are shifted out (clears on read) and pulses high for tw(DRH) before the next conversion if unread (clears on start); the two-sample FIFO behavior after a pause in reading; DRDY_HiZ open-drain option
  - SYNC/RESET: a low pulse shorter than 2048 tMCLK only resynchronizes conversions, longer resets the device; the model treats it as reset held low
  - SPI timeout (MODE.TIMEOUT), ID register low byte (reserved, xx: modeled 00h); RESET response 0011h for an incomplete frame

### ADS131B23P

High-voltage battery-pack monitor: two 24-bit current-shunt delta-sigma ADCs, one 16-bit 8-input sequenced ADC, overcurrent comparators, diagnostics and 9 GPIOs, SPI. `specs/ADS131B23P.json`; datasheet `ads131b23.pdf` (p.4-5 (pins), p.7 (ROC), p.14-15 (timing), p.28-31 (ADC1y filter, OSR, data), p.52-54 (modes, conversion modes), p.60-74 (serial interface, commands, reading data, DRDYn), p.74-212 (registers)).

- Bus: SPI mode 1
- 24 bits, 3 channel(s), code twos; vcc [2.9, 5.5]
- 127 registers, 7 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 15625–6.01074e+06 ns by ADC1A_CFG1.CONV_MODE1A+ADC1A_CFG1.OSR1A; start write:CONVERSION_CTRL.STARTA=1, write:CONVERSION_CTRL.STARTB=1
- Ready: DRDYn
- Packages: PHP (HTQFP-48-PHP)
- Not modeled:
  - this is a battery-pack monitor: only the SPI register interface and the ADC1A/ADC1B conversion timing are modeled; all analog parts (PGAs, muxes, references REFA/REFB, test DACs, open-wire current sources, temperature sensor, LDOs) are stored only and every result is the 0 V code
  - ADC1A and ADC1B are one conversion engine timed by ADC1A_CFG1 (CONV_MODE1A, OSR1A); ADC1B's own OSR/mode, separate STARTB timing, DRDY_CTRL (which ADC drives DRDYn), ADCxy_EN enables and global-chop mode (GC1y_EN, GC1y_DELAY) are not modeled
  - conversion time: continuous OSR / fMOD after the first; single-shot (3 x OSR + 44) / fMOD (Equation 19), at fMOD = 4.096 MHz (fMCLK 8.192 MHz); the first continuous conversion after STARTA also takes tSETTLE (modeled as OSR / fMOD)
  - ADC2A (16-bit, 8 inputs) and its 16-step sequencer (SEQ2A_STEPx_CFG, SEQ2A_START/STOP, SEQ2A_MODE, synchronized sequences): the SEQ2A_STEPx_DATA result registers stay at reset 0000h (= the 0 V code)
  - STOPx: only a single-register WREG of CONVERSION_CTRL with STOPA = 1 and STARTA = 0 stops conversions (other register bits of that write are dropped); STOPA/STOPB reading back 1 until stopped is not modeled
  - OP_MODE standby / power-down (DEVICE_CFG.OP_MODE) does not stop conversions; CLK_SOURCE, internal oscillators and clock monitors not modeled
  - every CRC: the command CRC and register-data CRC words are not checked (the real part executes nothing on a CRC mismatch), the output CRC word is output as zeros; CRC_TYPE, register map and memory map CRCs (REG_MAPx_CRC_EN, REGISTER_MAPx_CRC) not modeled
  - word length: modeled at the default 24-bit word size (DEVICE_CFG.WORD_LENGTH = 0); 32-bit words not modeled
  - multi-register RREG (only the first register with its address byte is output) and multi-register WREG (only the first register is written): the per-word padding cannot be expressed with rreg/wreg counts
  - STATUS word: COMMAND_RESPONSE is set to 1/2/3/4/6 per command; the error codes (1010b-1101b), the 0101b/1100b frame counter after RREG, the communication fault flags (SPI_CRC_FAULTn, SPI_TIMEOUTn, SCLK_COUNT_FAULTn, REG_ACCESS_FAULTn), CONV1A/CONV1B/SEQ2A counters, CLOCK and MODE indications are not modeled
  - LOCK: commands other than NULL, RREG and UNLOCK still execute while locked
  - supply, clock and digital monitors, fault flags and masks, FAULT pin, missing-host detection (MHD), overcurrent comparators (OCCA/OCCB pins, thresholds) not modeled
  - GPIOs (GPIO0-GPIO4, GPIO0A/1A/0B/1B), PWM outputs and readback: stored only, the pins are never driven; GPIO0A/1A/0B/1B use AVDD logic levels (listed in analog so the IOVDD check skips them)
  - SCLK counter and SPI timeout; SDO holding the last bit vs driving low after the frame (idle 0)
  - RESETn has an internal pulldown (floating = held in reset); the model treats Z as inactive
  - DRDYn: driven low during power-up/reset until the device is ready; goes high once the ADC1B data word is shifted out (clears on read) or when STARTx is written (clears on start); 4 tMCLK high pulse when data are not read
  - vcc 2.9-5.5 V is IOVDD (DPWR shorted to IOVDD, or the IOVDD LDO output from DPWR = 4-16 V); timing at 3.0-3.6 V IOVDD

  - the two sections A and B share one conversion engine: STARTA or STARTB starts it, STOPA or STOPB stops it; the conversion time and mode follow ADC1A_ADC3A_CFG (OSR13A, CONV_MODE13A) only; DRDY_CTRL, ADCxy_EN enables and the conversion/sequence counters in STATUS_LSB are not modeled
  - conversion time at the 8.192 MHz internal oscillator (fMOD 4.096 MHz): single-shot = tSETTLE = (3 OSR + 44) tMOD, continuous = OSR / fMOD (the first continuous conversion's longer settling time is not modeled); external CLK / CLK_SOURCE
  - OP_MODE standby / power-down (stored only), DRDYn held low during reset and the 4 tMCLK high pulse before a new DRDYn falling edge, DRDYn staying low when ADC3B data were not read
  - supply, clock and digital monitors, fault flags, masks, FAULT pin, missing-host detection (MHD), overcurrent comparators (OCCA/OCCB pins), GPIOs and PWM I/O (registers stored only; GPIO pins never driven)
  - RESETn internal pulldown (a floating RESETn holds the real device in reset; the model treats Z as inactive); tREGACQ / tPOR
  - STATUS_MSB fault bits 15:11 write-1-to-restore semantics (stored as written)

### ADS1601

16-bit 1.25 MSPS delta-sigma ADC with a high-speed serial output (SCLK, DOUT, FSO with complementary outputs). `specs/ADS1601.json`; datasheet `ads1601.pdf` (p.5 (supplies, digital levels), p.7 (pins), p.8 (timing), p.18 (format), p.19 (data retrieval, SYNC)).

- Bus: clocked 5-bit
- 16 bits, 1 channel(s), code twos; vcc [2.7, 5.25]
- 0 registers, 0 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: —
- Packages: PFB (TQFP-48-7X7)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input, internal / external reference (REFEN), RBIAS
  - the serial port is a master: one 16-bit word per 16 CLK periods (1.25 MSPS at fCLK = 20 MHz); each CLK rising edge shifts the next bit, SCLK/SCLKBAR follow CLK; the per-edge 5-bit pattern drives FSO, FSOBAR, DOUT, DOUTBAR, OTR
  - DOUTBAR is written as the constant complement of the 0 V code (all ones): a pattern cannot invert R
  - FSO is high for one CLK period during the LSB of the previous word (Figure 2); the word phase after power-up is arbitrary: SYNC (initialization, multi-device synchronization, FSO held low for tSTL = 833 CLK periods while the filter settles) is not modeled
  - OTR stays low (in-range 0 V input)
  - timing: tOut 20 ns = tCS (CLK rise to SCLK rise, 15 ns max) + tDS (SCLK rise to DOUT valid, 5 ns max); SCLK itself follows 15 ns after CLK; tCPW >= 25 ns
  - RPULLUP (pull-up to DVDD) and the PD / REFEN internal pull resistors

### ADS1625

18-bit 1.25 MSPS delta-sigma ADC with parallel output interface. `specs/ADS1625.json`; datasheet `ads1625.pdf` (p.5 (supplies, digital levels), p.7 (pins), p.8 (timing), p.20 (data format, CS/RD truth table), p.21 (reset)).

- Bus: parallel 18-bit
- 18 bits, 1 channel(s), code twos; vcc [2.7, 5.25]
- 0 registers, 0 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 800 ns; start power-on
- Ready: DRDY
- Packages: PAP (HTQFP-64-PAP)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input, modulator, digital filter settling (46 DRDY cycles after reset) and references (REFEN internal-reference enable is stored nowhere); the result is always the 0 V code 00000h
  - conversion pacing: the model runs a free 800 ns (32 x 25 ns, fCLK = 40 MHz nominal) conversion cycle; the real DRDY period is 32 CLK periods of whatever clock is on CLK (1-50 MHz), which the model does not follow
  - DRDY is modeled as a 400 ns low pulse after each conversion (the datasheet: low for 16 CLK periods, t4)
  - OTR out-of-range output is never driven (a 0 V input is never out of range: OTR would be low)

  - PD power-down supply behaviour and wake-up settling
  - FIFO_LEV[2:0] terminals must be left unconnected on the ADS1625 (role nc)

- 12 bits, 2 channel(s), code by R0.BTC; vcc [3.0, 3.6]
- 3 registers, 1 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: —
- Packages: PAG (TQFP-64-PAG)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs, references (INT/EXT select) and ISET bias: the result is always the 0 V (mid-scale) code (0x800 offset binary, 0 two's complement)
  - only the serial-interface mode (SEL = 1) is modeled: pins 41/42/45 are SEN/SCLK/SDATA; the parallel strap mode (SEL = 0: MSBI format select, OEA output enable, STPD power-down pins) is not. SEL low is modeled as reset (registers at 0, bus ignored), which the datasheet requires as a low pulse after power-up
  - register bits OEA_TRI/OEB_TRI (3-state), PDN/PDN_A/PDN_B (power-down), ALL_ZERO/ALL_ONE test patterns and PLL_DIS are stored only and do not change the outputs; serial register address 0001 is not documented
  - OEB: the clocked bus has one output enable, so OEB (pin 6) gates both the A and B outputs in the model
  - OVRA/OVRB over-range outputs are never driven (low for a 0 V input)
  - pipeline latency of 6 clock cycles (the code is constant); DVA/DVB data-valid outputs modeled as the inverted CLK (tDV CLK rising to DV falling, 30-55 % duty cycle)
  - serial interface is write-only (no read-back): the schema needs an SPI miso, so configBus names SDATA as miso with protocol out/idle "z" (never driven); 3-state enable/disable time of 2 clocks; PLL lock and clock-stop partial power-down (below 2 MSPS); power-up sequencing

### ADS5401

12-bit 800 MSPS ADC with DDR LVDS outputs and SPI configuration. `specs/ADS5401.json`; datasheet `ads5401.pdf` (p.3-5 (pins, ROC), p.10-11 (digital, timing), p.23-24 (serial interface), p.25-33 (registers)).

- Bus: clocked 12-bit; config SPI mode 0
- 12 bits, 1 channel(s), code by CONFIG1.FORMAT; vcc [1.7, 3.45]
- 12 registers, 3 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: —
- Packages: ZAY (NFBGA-196-ZAY)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs, references, auto-correction loops, decimation filter (CONFIG0.DEC_EN: data at half rate, high/low pass) and the temperature sensor: the result is always the 0 V code (0x000 two's complement, 0x800 offset binary) and TEMP reads 0
  - LVDS: the outputs are differential pairs; the model drives only the P legs (DAxP) as logic levels, the N legs and OVRA/SYNCOUT pairs are never driven; LVDS current, termination, per-pin output enables (0x66) and DACLK/OVRA enables are stored only
  - the differential clock CLKINP/CLKINN is modeled as CLKINP alone (each falling edge one sample); DACLK modeled as CLKINP / 2 (DDR: one sample per DACLK edge), DACLKN inverted; data and DACLK change tOut = tPD 3.92 ns after the edge (the datasheet centres DACLK in the data window)
  - pipeline latency (38/50/74 clocks) and over-range latency are not modeled (the code is constant); over-range threshold stored only
  - SPI 4-wire mode (CONFIG0.SPI_4WIRE: read data on SDO) is stored only; the model always reads back on SDIO (3-wire, the default); SDO is never driven
  - R/W = 1 disables further register writes until a write cycle clears it (not modeled); SDIO output timing is not specified (tOut shared with the data bus)
  - ENABLE low enters the sleep mode selected by register 0x37 (shutdown/standby/deep/light, wake-up 2 us-2.5 ms): modeled as powerdown, which also ignores the SPI bus
  - SYNCP/SYNCN synchronization input, SYNCOUT outputs and sync-select registers (0x0E/0x0F) are not modeled; TESTMODE is a factory pin (nc)
  - vcc is IOVDD (1.7-3.45 V) for SRESET/SDENB/SCLK/SDIO/SDO/ENABLE; DVDD and DVDDLVDS (1.7-1.9 V) are digital supplies in the same check

### ADS5500

14-bit 125 MSPS pipelined ADC with parallel CMOS outputs, output clock and 3-wire serial configuration port. `specs/ADS5500.json`; datasheet `ads5500.pdf` (p.2 (recommended operating conditions: AVDD/DRVDD 3.0-3.6 V, 60-125 MSPS DLL on, 2-80 MSPS DLL off), p.5 (digital VIH 2.4 V / VIL 0.8 V), p.6 (tSTART 2.9 ns max, tPDI 4.2-5.5 ns, CLKOUT polarity note 5), p.7 (latency 17.5 cycles; reset timing; serial interface: SDATA latched on SCLK falling while SEN low, 16-bit words, 4-bit address + 12-bit data), p.8 (Figures 3-4, Table 1 timing, Table 2 register table), p.9 (Table 3 DFS, pin configuration), p.10 (pin assignments), p.24-25 (PDN: outputs high impedance; OE active high; output format), p.27-28 (RESET pulse, default-write sequence 9/A/B/C/D 000, E 804, 0/1/F 000)).

- Bus: clocked 15-bit; config SPI mode 2
- 14 bits, 1 channel(s), code by DFS; vcc [3.0, 3.6]
- 9 registers, 3 commands; frame stream
- Conversion: —
- Packages: PAP (HTQFP-64-PAP)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input, references and clock DLL (the result is always the 0 V code: mid-scale in straight binary, 0 in two's complement)
  - pipeline latency of 17.5 clock cycles (the code is constant)
  - DFS is a four-level analog strap (Table 3: straight binary / two's complement x CLKOUT polarity); the model reads it as a logic level: low = straight binary (offset), high = two's complement. The levels between (two's complement with rising-edge CLKOUT, straight binary with falling-edge CLKOUT) cannot be expressed, nor the CLKOUT polarity change (data valid on CLKOUT falling edge adds half a clock period)
  - OVR (over-range) is modeled as an extra data bit that is always 0: bus data is OVR then the data bits MSB first, read pattern "0R{n}"
  - CLKOUT and the data share tOut = tSTART max (input clock rising to data valid start); CLKOUT really follows tPDI 4.2-5.5 ns after the input clock
  - serial port is write-only (no readback pin); the schema needs a MISO pin, so SDATA is named as both MOSI and MISO with out/idle "z" (the part never drives it)
  - register test modes TP (forced 0/1/toggle outputs) and DLL on/off are stored but do not change the outputs
  - PDN power-down puts the data outputs in high impedance; the model only stops conversions
  - RESET also forces the data outputs low; internal 200 kOhm pullup on RESET to AVDD
  - OE to stable output timing (1000 clock cycles) and wake-up times
  - pins OE, DFS, SEN, SDATA, SCLK are clamped to DRVDD; vcc is the DRVDD range

  - pipeline latency 17.5 clock cycles not modeled (the code is constant); data valid tSTART (max 5.0 ns) after the input clock rising edge, CLKOUT tPDI later; OVR (over-range) is driven as the top data bit, always 0 at 0 V
  - CLKP/CLKM are a differential (or single-ended) sampling clock: the model clocks on CLKP alone
  - the serial port is write-only (no read-back pin); the schema needs a MISO pin, so SDATA is named as both MOSI and MISO with out/idle z (the part never drives it); words beyond a multiple of 16 bits are ignored
  - test modes TP<1:0> (outputs forced to 0 / 1 / toggling) are stored only, they do not change the outputs
  - PDN power-down: the model blocks conversions; the datasheet puts the outputs in high impedance (not modeled) and the bus stays usable; power-down by clock below 2 MSPS not modeled
  - RESET has an internal 200 kOhm pull-up to AVDD (a floating RESET pin reads inactive in the model); RESET timing (2 us pulse, 10 ms after power-on) not modeled
  - OE to stable timing (1000 clock cycles) and wake-up times not modeled
  - OE, DFS, SEN, SDATA, SCLK clamp to DRVDD; RESET is referred to AVDD

- Bus: SPI mode 2
- 12 bits, 4 channel(s), code twos; vcc [2.3, 5.5]
- 6 registers, 20 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 875 ns; start pin
- Ready: BUSY
- Packages: RHB (VQFN-32-5X5)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs, the 2x2 fully-differential / 4x2 pseudo-differential multiplexer (PDE), CMA/CMB and the reference DACs on REFIO1/REFIO2: every conversion returns the 0 V (differential) code 0000h; REFIO1/REFIO2 are never driven

  - SDOB (converter B in modes I and III) is never driven; SDOA always shifts converter A's frame then converter B's frame (40 clocks: channel indicator, ADC indicator 0/1, result, trailing zeros), which is the mode II / IV SDOA-only order (M1 = 1) and whose first 20 bits are the mode I / III SDOA frame (M1 = 0); mode II's leading '0' instead of the channel indicator is not modeled
  - CID = 1 (no channel/ADC indicator bits), the 2-bit counter (CE), special read modes (SR), FIFO (FE, SEQFIFO.FD) and the pseudo-differential sequencer (SEQFIFO) do not change the output; M0/M1 strap pins are not read (automatic channel selection and the M0 = 1 'no action' of R = 00/11 are not modeled)
  - pipeline: SDOA shows the result of the previous conversion in hardware (data n-1); the model's result is the constant 0 V code, so the pipeline is not visible; the channel indicator is CONFIG.C1 at conversion start, without the one-conversion channel-latch delay (channel latched at the 2nd CLOCK falling edge)
  - conversion time is 17.5 CLOCK periods at the 20 MHz half-clock maximum (875 ns); the real conversion runs on the external CLOCK (17.5 tCLK half-clock, 35 tCLK full-clock mode, FC), and CONVST pulses ignored in mode II / during a running conversion are not modeled
  - power-down, sleep and auto-sleep modes (PD) and their wake-up times

- 12 bits, 6 channel(s), code twos; vcc [4.75, 5.25]

### ADS7924

12-bit 4-channel micro-power SAR ADC with I2C interface, window comparator alarms and interrupt. `specs/ADS7924.json`; datasheet `ads7924.pdf` (p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.5 (electrical: straight binary, VIH), p.6 (I2C timing), p.11-13 (data format, conversion timing, INT, PWRCON, alarm), p.13-20 (modes, Table 1, Figures 22-28), p.21 (Table 2 addresses 48h/49h), p.22-25 (Figures 29-33), p.26 (Table 3 register map and reset values), p.27-32 (Figures 34-56, Table 4)).

- Bus: I2C 0x48, 0x49
- 12 bits, 4 channel(s), code straight; vcc [1.65, 5.5]
- 24 registers, 3 commands; frame stream
- Conversion: 12000–86400 ns by ACQCONFIG.ACQTIME; start write:MODECNTRL.MODE5_1=24, write:MODECNTRL.MODE5_1=25
- Ready: INT
- Packages: RTE (WQFN-16-RTE)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs, multiplexer, MUXOUT/ADCIN break-out and AVDD reference (every conversion returns the 0 V code 000h)
  - operating modes: MODE[5:0] is split into MODE5_1 (bits 7:3) and MODE0 (bit 2) so that a write of 110000 / 110010 (manual-single / manual-scan) starts one conversion and MODE0 = 1 (the auto modes 110001, 110011, 111001, 111011, 111111) runs continuously; codes the datasheet does not list behave the same way; idle and awake (MODE0 = 0) stop conversions
  - scan modes convert all four channels in turn starting at SEL/ID; the model converts only the selected channel, so only that channel's DATAx registers load; SEL/ID does not read back the last channel converted
  - conversion time = tACQ (ACQTIME x 2 us + 6 us) + tCONV 4 us, scaled by 1.2 for the +-20% internal clock; the power-up time tPU (PWRUPTIME x 2 us, applied after idle/awake) and the sleep time of the sleep modes (SLPTIME 2.5-320 ms, SLPDIV4, SLPMULT8) between conversions are not modeled
  - RESET (16h) reads the device ID 0001100 A0: ID0 follows the A0 pin through pins.levels
  - alarm: 8-bit window comparators (ULRx/LLRx), alarm counters (ALMCNT), ALRM_ST status bits, AEN/ST read-back of the alarm status, clearing on an INTCNTRL read, and the INT alarm configuration (INTCNFG = 000, the reset value): INT is never driven for alarms
  - INT: only active-low polarity (INTPOL = 0, the default) is modeled; with INTPOL = 1 the pin stays inactive; busy (INTCNFG 001/011/111) and data ready (010 one conversion, 110 all four conversions: modeled as one conversion) are modeled, static or a 250-ns pulse (INTTRIG); data ready clears when the data registers are read (the datasheet: when the lower four bits are retrieved; the model clears it on any DATAx read)
  - CONVCTRL (stop conversions at the control event until it is cleared) is stored only
  - PWRCON pin (external op-amp power control, PWRCONEN / PWRCONPOL, AVDD-referred levels) is never driven; CALCNTL (MUXOUT to AGND) is stored only
  - power-on values of INTCNTRL bits 7:4, DATAx, ULRx, LLRx are undefined (XXh / X0h): 0 used
  - I2C bus time-out (25 ms idle), standard / fast mode timing limits; the A0 pin is sampled continuously (the address table follows it)

- 14 bits, 2 channel(s), code twos; vcc [1.65, 5.25]
- 1 registers, 0 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 0 ns; start cs-fall
- Packages: RTE (WQFN-16-RTE)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs, reference and multiplexer settling; conversion is clocked by SCLK (16 SCLK, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)
  - 16-clock frame pipelining (SDO shows sample N-1 while converting sample N): the 0 V code is constant, so the output is the same
  - bits after D0 in the 16-clock frame are undefined in the datasheet (shown as don't-care); modeled as 0
  - 32-clock frame mode (CS held low to the 30th SCLK falling edge: the next frame outputs 16 zeros, then the data of the current sample)
  - PDEN auto power-down (PDEN high at the CS rising edge powers the device down after the conversion; CS rising with PDEN low wakes it): PDEN is an input with no effect
  - conversion abort (CS high during the first 16 clocks invalidates the next frame's data)
  - throughput, acquisition time and SCLK frequency limits

### ADS7950

12-bit 1 MSPS 4-channel SAR ADC with SPI interface, auto/manual channel sequencing, GPIOs and alarms. `specs/ADS7950.json`; datasheet `ads7950.pdf` (p.6-9 (pin functions), p.10 (ROC: +VBD 1.7 V to +VA, +VA max 5.25 V), p.17 (timing requirements, 1.8 V column: td1 38, td2 35, td4 24 ns; tconv 16 SCLK), p.18-19 (Figures 2-4 frame: DO15-12 channel address, MSB on 4th SCLK fall, SDO 3-state at 16th fall; SDI latched on SCLK rise), p.28 (operation), p.33 (Table 1 manual), p.36 (Table 2 Auto-1), p.37 (Tables 3-4 Auto-1 program), p.39 (Table 5 Auto-2), p.41 (Tables 6-8), p.42 (Tables 9-10 straight binary), p.43 (Table 11 GPIO), p.45 (Table 13 alarms)).

- Bus: SPI mode 0
- 12 bits, 4 channel(s), code straight; vcc [1.7, 5.25]
- 13 registers, 24 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 0 ns; start cs-fall
- Packages: DBT (TSSOP-30), RGE (VQFN-24-RGE)
- Not modeled:
  - analog multiplexer, MXO/AINP breakout, input ranges (CTRL.RANGE stored only; both ranges are unipolar, 0 V = code 0)
  - pipeline latency: a manual-mode channel written in frame n is converted at the start of frame n+2 (modeled: frame n+1); [CH] shows the channel selected when the conversion starts
  - Auto-1 / Auto-2 channel sequencing: the channel counter never advances (modeled: entering or continuing an auto mode selects channel 0, which is the first channel of the reset Auto-1 sequence and of every Auto-2 sequence); AUTO1/AUTO2 are stored only
  - alarm comparison and the GPIO0/GPIO1 alarm outputs (ALARM_Hn/ALARM_Ln are written through the 11bb sequence and stored only; the 0 V code never trips the reset thresholds 3FFh/000h)
  - GPIO pins: GPO data (CTRL.GPO) is never driven onto GPIO0-3 and GPI levels are not read; with DI04=1 DO15-12 shift the stored GPO bits (CTRL.GPO) in place of the GPIO pin levels
  - GPIO2 as range input and GPIO3 as asynchronous active-low power-down input (GPIO_CFG.RANGE_EN / PD_EN stored only)
  - power-down via DI05=1 takes effect at the 16th SCLK of the next frame (modeled: at the end of the frame that writes it); wake-up on the CS fall with DI05=0 is modeled as the end of that frame
  - DI09=1 GPIO-program reset happens in the next CS frame (modeled: at the end of the writing frame)
  - first frame after power-up outputs invalid SDO (modeled: channel 0 / 0 V code)
  - trailing bits after the LSB for 10-bit (DO1-0) and 8-bit (DO3-0) devices are not specified; modeled as 0
  - SCLK frequency (20 MHz max) and quiet time tq

- 12 bits, 1 channel(s), code by MSBI; vcc [4.75, 5.25]
- 0 registers, 0 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: —
- Packages: DW (SOIC-28W)

  - analog input, internal references (REFT/REFB bypass, CM output); the result is always the 0 V differential (bipolar zero) code: 800h straight offset binary, 000h with MSBI high

### ADS8028

12-bit 1 MSPS 8-channel SAR ADC with internal temperature sensor, internal reference and SPI interface. `specs/ADS8028.json`; datasheet `ads8028.pdf` (p.2 (abs max), p.4 (electrical: DVDD), p.6 (timing, Figure 1), p.7 (pins), p.16 (straight binary), p.17 (serial interface), p.18 (Control Register, Table 2), p.19 (Table 3 output format), p.20-22 (temperature sensor, modes), p.23-24 (PD/RST)).

- Bus: SPI mode 2
- 12 bits, 9 channel(s), code straight; vcc [1.65, 5.25]
- 2 registers, 11 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 0–100000 ns by CHSEL.ADD; start cs-fall
- Ready: TM_BUSY
- Packages: RTJ (QFN-20-RTJ)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs, reference selection (EXT_REF stored only); the result is always the 0 V code 000h; the temperature sensor channel (8/9) also returns 000h (0 degC in twos complement)
  - channel sequencing: with several AIN bits set the device converts the selected channels in ascending order in successive frames, REPEAT re-runs the sequence, and DOUT returns all 1s when the sequence is complete or no channel is selected; the model converts the last single channel written (a multi-channel write keeps the previous channel code)
  - pipelining: the channel written in frame N is converted in frame N+1 and read in N+2; the model converts at each CS fall on the channel already selected, so ADD[3:0] reports it one frame early
  - the 16-SCLK rule: a CS rise before 16 SCLKs aborts the conversion and leaves the Control Register unchanged (the commands only complete at 16 bits, so the register part is honored)
  - TM_BUSY blocking: while a temperature conversion runs (100 us) further frames are ignored and DOUT returns all 1s; STANDBY = 1 aborts it
  - STANDBY mode (stored only) and the power-up times tPU_STANDBY / tPOWER_UP
  - PD/RST: a low pulse < 60 ns resets the Control Register, > 90 ns enters power-down (also resetting the register); both are modeled as reset while low
  - temperature averaging filter (TMP_AVG)
  - pin table lists TM_BUSY as 'Digital input'; it is the busy output (p.7, p.20)
  - SPI mode: SCLK idles high (Figure 1), DIN latched and DOUT launched on SCLK falling edges with the first bit (ADD3) out at CS fall: mode 2

- Bus: SPI mode 2
- 16 bits, 1 channel(s), code straight; vcc [1.65, 5.5]
- 1 registers, 6 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 1714.3 ns; start pin
- Ready: EOC/INT/CDI
- Packages: PW (TSSOP-16), RSA (QFN-16-RSA)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input and external reference: every conversion returns the 0 V code 0000h
  - conversion time is 18 CCLK at the 10.5 MHz minimum internal clock (+VBD = 1.8 V table, 1714.3 ns); CCLK = SCLK/2 (CFR D10 = 0), the 21-CCLK auto-trigger cycle (D9 = 0) and the minimum CONVST spacing are not timed; with auto trigger the model converts back to back
  - quiet zone around end of sampling and the pipelined result (FS/CS falling before the end of conversion reads the previous result): the model always outputs the constant 0 V code
  - SDO outputs all 1s during the first cycle after power-on or software reset (the model outputs the normal frame)
  - daisy-chain mode (CFR D5 = 0: EOC/INT/CDI becomes the chain data input, 16/24-SCLK pass-through); with D5 = 0 the pin is left inactive
  - power-down modes: deep power-down (D2), nap (D3), auto nap (D4) and their wake-up times; CFR bits are stored only, Wake up sets D3/D2
  - the 4-bit CMR is not readable; the CFR read-back reply starts after the 4 command bits (the 4 result MSBs before it are the frame's normal output)
  - SPI mode: the part samples SDI and changes SDO on SCLK falling edges and works with CPOL = 0, CPHA = 1 or CPOL = 1, CPHA = 0 (p.29); modeled as mode 2
  - reserved CMR codes 2h-Ah (ignored)
  - CMR 0h/1h channel select commands apply to the dual-channel sibling only (ignored here)
  - CFR reset value: Table 5 gives D8 default 0 while the text says all 1s (except D1); the table value is used

- Conversion: 3300 ns; start cs-rise
- Packages: DGS (VSSOP-10)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input and reference (the 0 V code is 0000h)
  - mode selection by the SDI level at the CONVST rising edge: only 3-wire CS mode without a busy indicator (SDI high, CONVST as CS) is modeled; SDI is not read

### ADS8341

16-bit 100 kSPS 4-channel SAR ADC with start-bit serial interface. `specs/ADS8341.json`; datasheet `ads8341.pdf` (p.2 (pins, ordering: E = SSOP-16 DBQ), p.3-4 (specs), p.11 (Tables I-II), p.12 (digital interface, Figure 3), p.13 (Tables III-V), p.14 (clock modes, Tables VI-VII, Figures 4-6, data format)).

- Bus: SPI mode 0
- 16 bits, 4 channel(s), code straight; vcc [2.7, 5.25]
- 2 registers, 5 commands; frame stream
- Conversion: 0–8000 ns by CLKMODE.INT; start command
- Ready: BUSY
- Packages: DBQ (QSOP-16)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs, multiplexer and SGL/DIF selection (stored only); every conversion returns the 0 V code 0000h; A2-A0 codes 000/011/100/111 are not listed in Tables I-II
  - external clock mode: the conversion is clocked by DCLK (16 clocks after the control byte); not timed, the result is ready at once; BUSY is a one-DCLK HIGH pulse after the control byte on the part, the model only drives it LOW
  - internal clock mode: BUSY low for up to 8 us (modeled as an 8 us conversion); the part shifts the MSB on the first DCLK falling edge after BUSY rises, the model shifts the reply right after the control byte (the 0 V code is all zeros either way); reading after CS was high during the conversion is not modeled separately
  - a clock-mode change needs one extra conversion cycle on the part; the model switches with the control byte that selects it
  - DOUT and BUSY are Hi-Z while CS is high (the bus model floats DOUT; BUSY is driven), except BUSY in internal clock mode
  - power-down selection PD1-PD0 = 00 (auto power-down between conversions has no bus effect)
  - overlapped 24-clock conversions where the next start bit arrives while the previous result is still shifting (Figure 3): the model restarts the reply at the new control byte
  - timing values are the 2.7-3.6 V table (Table VI, 200 ns); at 4.75-5.25 V they are 70-100 ns (Table VII)

### ADS8350

16-bit 750 kSPS dual simultaneous-sampling SAR ADC, pseudo-differential inputs, SPI-compatible serial interface. `specs/ADS8350.json`; datasheet `ads8350.pdf` (p.3 (pin configuration and functions), p.4 (ROC: AVDD 5 V nom, DVDD 3.3 V nom), p.5 (electrical characteristics: DVDD 1.65-5.5 V, VIH/VIL), p.9 (timing requirements, switching characteristics: tCONV 590 ns, tDV_CSDO 12 ns, tDZ_CSDO 10 ns, tD_CKDO 20 ns; Figure 1), p.23 (Table 1 transfer characteristics, twos complement), p.24 (serial interface, Figure 52, Table 2), p.25 (frame abort)).

- Bus: SPI mode 2, read-only
- 16 bits, 2 channel(s), code twos; vcc [1.65, 5.5]
- 0 registers, 0 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 590 ns; start cs-fall
- Packages: RTE (WQFN-16-RTE)
- Not modeled:
  - analog inputs and references: every conversion returns the 0 V (AINP_x - AINM_x = 0) code, twos complement 0
  - channel B: both ADCs sample simultaneously but only SDO-A (ADC_A result) is modeled; SDO-B (ADC_B result, same frame) is never driven
  - the conversion runs during SCLK 1-14 after CS falls (tCONV 590 ns max); the result is the constant 0 V code, so it is not tied to the SCLK count
  - frame abort / short-cycling: CS high before the 15th SCLK falling edge aborts the conversion; CS high later aborts the transfer (tPH_CS_SHRT); the minimum 31 SCLK falling edges per frame are not checked

  - WKEY protection modeled for WRITE/SET/CLEAR of RST_PWRCTL_REG bits 7-0 (written only while WKEY = 69h, from an earlier frame); PWRDN / NAP_EN power modes stored only
  - RSTn_APP: application vs power-on reset (both modeled as register reset while RST is low); 20 ms POR recovery
  - RVS shows the conversion state only while CS is high; during a CS-low SPI frame it stays low (modeled: low only while converting)
  - frames shorter than 32 SCLKs are NOPs (modeled: the command does not complete); frames longer than 32 SCLKs use the last 32 bits and daisy-chain (modeled: the first 32 bits)
  - registers are byte registers named <REG without _REG and underscores><byte 0-3> (DATAOUTCTL0 = DATAOUT_CTL_REG bits 7-0) at the datasheet byte addresses; half-word commands are listed per half-word because a half-word's MS byte is the higher address
  - SCLK frequency limit (66.67 MHz) and tacq
  - alarm thresholds compare INP_ALRM_*_TH[15:4] (12-bit result); the lower bits must be 0 (stored as written)

- Ready: BUSY
- Packages: PZA (LQFP-80-PZA)
- Not modeled:
  - only the software serial interface mode is modeled (SER/BYTE/PAR = 1, DB9/BYTESEL = 0, HW_RNGSEL[1:0] = 00 at full reset, serial 1-wire: A then B result on SDOA); the strap pins are not read

  - serial 2-wire mode (B result on DB11/SDOB, DB4/SER1W strap): SDOB is never driven
  - SPI mode: the datasheet text says mode 00 but Figure 6-5 shows SCLK idle high, MSB at CS fall, SDI sampled on SCLK falling and SDO changing on SCLK rising: modeled as mode 2
  - analog inputs, PGA ranges (RANGE_xx, OVER_RANGE_SETTING_x), LPF_CONFIG, reference selection (REFSEL), diagnostic channels AVDD/ALDO and fixed codes 0x5555/0xAAAA (stored only; the 0 V code is 0000h in twos complement)
  - software sequencer and burst mode (SEQ_STACK_n, SEQEN, BURSTEN, SSREN), oversampling filter output (OSR only sets the conversion time), STATUS/CRC words appended to the result (STATUSEN/CRCEN), STATUS register contents
  - registers are 16 bits with the command header W/R (bit 15) and REGADDR (bits 14-9) as datasheet reset values; a write stores data bits 8-0, the header bits are kept read-only
  - the datasheet defines no NOP word; a read of the unmapped address 0x0 is decoded as NOP so that conversion-read frames with SDI low keep shifting results
  - partial reset (RESET low 40-500 ns) vs full reset (>= 1.2 us), 15 ms start-up after full reset, shutdown mode, SDEF self-test flag
  - SCLK period limits by DVDD (50/25/20 ns) and tACQ

- Bus: SPI mode 0
- 16 bits, 1 channel(s), code offset; vcc [1.65, 5.25]
- 36 registers, 62 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 5000 ns; start cs-rise
- Ready: RVS
- Packages: PW (TSSOP-16)
- Not modeled:
  - analog front end, PGA, input ranges and internal reference (RANGE_SEL stored only; the 0 V code is 8000h, mid-scale of the default bipolar ±3 × VREF range in straight binary; unipolar ranges would give 0)
  - SPI mode select SDI_MODE (only the power-on SPI-00-S, mode 0, is modeled), dual SDO (SDO1_CONFIG = 11b), source-synchronous / ADC-clock output protocols (SDO_MODE = 11b, SSYNC_CLK)

  - SCLK frequency limit (66.67 MHz) and tacq

### ADS8902

20-bit 500 kSPS fully differential SAR ADC with integrated reference buffer and LDO, enhanced-SPI interface (ADS8902B). `specs/ADS8902.json`; datasheet `ads8904b.pdf` (p.4 (pins), p.6 (ROC: DVDD 1.65-5.5 V), p.10-11 (timing), p.25 (transfer function), p.29-31 (commands, output data word), p.32-33 (frame), p.40 (SPI protocols), p.53-58 (registers)).

- Bus: SPI mode 0
- 20 bits, 1 channel(s), code twos; vcc [1.65, 5.5]
- 9 registers, 8 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: 1200 ns; start pin
- Ready: RVS
- Packages: RGE (VQFN-24-RGE)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input, reference input, reference buffer and LDO; the result is always the 0 V differential code 00000h (twos complement)
  - 22-bit command word decoded from the last 22 SDI bits before CS rises (align end); frames shorter than 22 SCLKs are NOPs (p.32-33 data transfer frame)
  - SPI protocol selection: SDI_MODE (SPI-01/10/11) and SDO_MODE early data launch / source-synchronous output, SDO_WIDTH dual/quad SDO, DATA_RATE (DDR), SSYNC_CLK_SEL with RVS as strobe: stored only; the bus stays SPI-00-S on SDO-0 (SDO-1..3 never driven)
  - parity bits FLPAR/FTPAR (PAR_EN, FPAR_LOC): stored only; the parity positions output 0, which is correct for the 0 V code but not for register read-back or nonzero test patterns
  - PD_ADC power-down is modeled only for WR_REG to PD_CNTL (SET_BITS/CLR_BITS on PD_CNTL change the bit without powering down); PD_REFBUF, power-up times tPU_ADC / tPU_REFBUF, RST-to-RVS delay td_rst 3 ms
  - RVS while CS is low (low from CS fall, then per output protocol) and the td_CSRDY_r delay after CS rise: not modeled; RVS is low while converting
  - offset calibration (REF_SEL) and reference margining (EN_MARG, REF_OFST): stored only
  - conversion time varies 1100-1200 ns (modeled: tconv max 1200 ns); cycle time, acquisition and quiet-zone timing, SCLK frequency limits
  - reserved command codes: treated as NOP (unmatched)

10-bit 20 MSPS +3 V pipelined ADC with internal reference and parallel CMOS outputs. `specs/ADS900.json`; datasheet `ads900.pdf` (p.2-3 (specifications), p.4 (pins, timing), p.9 (output data, OE, Table I), p.11 (digital outputs, LVDD), p.12 (power-down)).

- Bus: clocked 10-bit
- 10 bits, 1 channel(s), code offset; vcc [2.7, 3.7]
- 0 registers, 0 commands; frame fixed
- Conversion: —
- Packages: DB (SSOP-28)
- Not modeled:
  - analog input and internal reference (ladder bypass LpBy/LnBy, CM and 1VREF outputs); the result is always the 0 V differential (bipolar zero) code 200h, straight offset binary (single-ended use: IN at 1.5 V gives the same code)
  - pipeline latency of 5 clock cycles (the code is constant); data invalid for 5 clocks after leaving power-down
  - clock period / duty-cycle limits (50 ns to 100 us) and aperture delay
  - two supplies: +VS 2.7-3.7 V (analog core and CLK/OE/Pwrdn inputs) and LVDD (output drivers); the datasheet gives no LVDD range (specified at LVDD = +3 V), so vcc is the +VS range and +VS is listed under analog so LVDD is the digital supply
  - the clock input is described as accepting +5 V or +3 V CMOS levels (p.11) but the absolute maximum logic input is +VS + 0.3 V; inputMax is not set
  - 3-state enable time (40 ns max) differs from the disable time (10 ns); tFloat uses the disable time; internal 50 kOhm pull-downs on OE and Pwrdn (OE floating = enabled)
  - pin 24 is the complementary input (IN with an overbar in the datasheet); both inputs are named IN

  - write-read mode reading before td(int) (RD low earlier latches the result after RD falls, INT low at td(RIL) 290 ns max; ta(R1) 320 ns)
  - INT is reset by the rising edge of either RD or CS (p.3); the model clears it when the read ends
  - OFLW overflow output (normally high, low when the input exceeds REF+) is not driven
  - conversion starts at the WR falling edge in the datasheet; the model starts it when WR/CS are released and times td(int) from there (which is how the datasheet times INT)
  - tw(W) 0.5-50 us write pulse, td(NC) 500 ns between conversions, td(WR) 0.4 us
  - tAcc uses ta(R2) 150 ns (CL = 100 pF, td(WR) > td(int)); tDf uses tdis 95 ns
  - pin names: REF - / REF + written REF- / REF+; D0 (LSB) / D7 (MSB) written D0 / D7; the FN (PLCC) package is obsolete and not in the skeleton
